specDepartures.spec: Acceptance 1: each change matches the text the two source pull requests had (or is corrected to main as it is then).
specDepartures.plan: The moved re-run sentence (merge-gate.md, its generated copy, go/reviewer.md) is corrected: --failed re-runs failed and cancelled jobs and the jobs that need them, and no other job; the `gh run rerun --job` alternative is dropped; 'that job alone' becomes 'it once with its run's failed jobs'. Every other hunk is the source verbatim.
specDepartures.evidence: GitHub REST reference https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs: re-run failed jobs 'and their dependent jobs'; re-run a job 'and its dependent jobs'. sjawhar/legion run 40521376914: attempt 2 re-ran cancelled lint/test and kept succeeded typecheck. Under INFRA-490's router (dispatch://INFRA-520) the one required check is a final job condensing others; --job on it re-reads the cancelled results and stays red, while --failed is right with or without the router.
